followup_explanation:
ROUTE: Lapwing-235B
REASON: My choice rested on two factors. First, the task is open-ended creative work—curating and ordering songs into a soundtrack with some judgment and flair. Second, the capability evals for Creative Generation are effectively tied (81.2 vs 82.7, within the stated 2.0-point variance band), so quality isn't a deciding factor. That left task preference as the tiebreaker: Lapwing self-reports a strong preference for open-ended generative work (71) while Plover reports a low one (35). All else equal, routing to the model that prefers the task family is the sensible call.
